description: Defines the FrontPanelTextDisplay class and its nested classes for managing front panel text display, including modes, scrolling, brightness, and time formatting.

classes.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay
classes.description: Manages front panel text display mode, scrolling, brightness, and time format.

classes.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::Mode
classes.description: Extends DSConstant to manage display modes like time or text display.

classes.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::Scroll
classes.description: Handles scrolling parameters such as vertical/horizontal iterations and hold duration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of FrontPanelTextDisplay by id or name.

methods.name: getTextBrightnessLevels
methods.description: Retrieves brightness levels and min/max bounds.

methods.name: getCurrentTimeFormat
methods.description: Gets the current time format setting (12hr or 24hr).

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets display mode: both, text only, or clock only.
